'''Ione''' was a thriving [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] lying along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Originally settled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Ione occupied a key intersection on the Trade Spine that made it the sole [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] link to the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region's four [[Mining Worlds/Legends|Mining Worlds]].

The [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company used Ione as its entry point for operations throughout the surrounding area. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] likewise used the [[Ione system/Legends|Ione system]] as their staging point for launching reconnaissance [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to neighboring planets in search of the secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|base]].

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Ione was the namesake of the [[Ione system/Legends|Ione system]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region,<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A thriving [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] world,<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> Ione lay at the heart of the sprawling [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|112|Ione}}</ref> and sat at a strategic intersection point along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. Ione's position made it the sole link between the Trade Spine and the four Greater Javin planets known collectively as the [[Mining Worlds/Legends|Mining Worlds]]: [[Burnin Konn/Legends|Burnin Konn]], [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]], and [[Isis/Legends|Isis]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Ione featured a primarily terrestrial surface of [[City/Legends|urban]] development, [[Ocean/Legends|seas]], and plateaus, and the planet offered a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate. A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Ione lasted twenty-three [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard hours]], and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 390 local days. The planet had standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] breathable for [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==History==
===Republic settlement and FiggEx mining===
A [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]] before the onset of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet Ione lay in a largely uncharted region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] beyond the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], which was considered then to be a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. At a [[Time/Legends|time]] when the Corellian Trade Spine had yet to extend past the edge of the Mid Rim, only [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and the most daring [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] traversed this imperfectly surveyed frontier region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Efforts by [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorers to expand the Trade Spine's economic opportunities were long hampered by the dominating presence of the giant [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]], which proved a great impediment to [[Astrogation/Legends|navigation]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

[[File:IoneMiningWorlds-HGJ.png|thumb|left|230px|Ione stood as the sole hyperspace entry point to the four planets known as the Mining Worlds.]]
Following a brief, one-sided [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the region's native [[Mugaari]], Republic [[Cartographer/Legends|cartographers]] established the new [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the Outer Rim, and a host of planets running Rimward along the Trade Spine, including Ione, were settled. Republic traders, staging from these newly settled planets, continued to search for a hyperspace shortcut through the Twin Nebulae, but [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] passed before the entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] succeeded in finding a route. Figg's success turned Ione's region into an economic powerhouse.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="Date-400 BBY">"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}), states that the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] was established in the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg's]] life. The text states that Figg [[Death/Legends|died]] nearly four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to its setting, thus providing an approximate date of [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] for the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] establishment.</ref> Ione was reorganized into the Republic's new Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Eventually, [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]], the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] subsidiary of Figg's [[Outer Javin Company]], began using Ione as its entry point for operations throughout the Ivax Nebula,<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> including the four [[Star system/Legends|systems]] branching off from Ione known as the Mining Worlds.<ref name="Atlas" /> A less-than-loyal member of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]], Figg Excavations represented the public face of the [[Figg conglomerate]] in the area around Ione.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:StalkerStalking-ESB.png|thumb|right|250px|Staging from the Ione system, the Imperial Star Destroyer ''Stalker'' launched a probe droid that discovered the Rebel Alliance's Echo Base on nearby Hoth.]]
During the Galactic Civil War, a once-secret [[Ione–Isis hyperroute|hyperroute]] connected Ione with the one-time [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] Isis.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date-3 ABY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. This includes the film's opening scene, which takes place in the [[Ione system/Legends|Ione system]], according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.</ref> the Ione system served as the staging point for the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'', temporarily detached from the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], as they launched reconnaissance [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to surrounding planets in the Empire's ongoing search for the secret [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Rebel headquarters]].<ref name="Atlas" />

From Ione, the two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] dispatched [[Probe droid/Legends|probots]] to the nearby [[Allyuen system/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Tokmia system/Legends|Tokmia]], and [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth systems]]. Ultimately, the probe sent to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="Atlas" /> by the ''Stalker''<ref name="Stalker">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=''Stalker''}}</ref> led to the discovery of the Rebels' hidden [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] and the subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Inhabitants==
Ione boasted a mixed-[[Species/Legends|species]] population of 1 billion inhabitants.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> The population was evenly distributed among Humans, [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]], [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiins]], and [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Ione's populace was governed by a corporate entity.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

The planet's primary imports included technology and [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]], and its exports included [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and [[Gemstone|gems]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Locations==
Regarded chiefly as a port world, Ione featured two [[Stellar-class starport|stellar]] and three standard spaceports.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ione was created for "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|online]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', published in [[2009]], established the Ione system as the setting for the opening scene of the film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], in which an Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] launches the probe [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that discovers the Rebel base on Hoth.<ref name="Atlas" />
